description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A shallow elongated woven cradle holds one blank removable ceramic spoon-rest insert. Side: The ceramic insert curves upward at one end above low bamboo feet. Rear: The rear rim shows a fitted lip securing the removable insert. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of this exact rattan/bamboo household object. Create ONE corrected side catalog photo by camera movement only. The camera views the NARROW RIGHT END of the elongated spoon-rest holder, rotated a full 90 degrees from its long front face. The end facing viewer is the raised curved ceramic end. The long trough recedes directly away from viewer and must be dramatically foreshortened; image silhouette should be only about one-fifth the original long front-view width. Show a short rounded end wall and two overlapping end feet, not the full long woven side. Do not mirror or repeat the long front silhouette. Preserve exact original proportions, color, weave, number and location of all supports, compartments, rods, legs and plain secondary inserts. Previously hidden rear geometry is inferred but must plausibly support this exact object without redesign. Whole product centered on same warm-white seamless studio background, soft light and shadow, no props. NO TEXT, labels, logos, numbers or markings.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
